response.sql: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc WHERE arcref IS NOT NULL GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_projects FROM project_counts), with_metrics AS (SELECT pc.arcref, pc.cnt, CAST(pc.cnt AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.total_count AS DECIMAL) as share, CAST(pc.cnt AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.total_count AS DECIMAL) - 1.0 / CAST(t.num_projects AS DECIMAL) as deviation FROM project_counts pc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT arcref, cnt, share, deviation FROM with_metrics ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10
